_about: Notes on terms of config/ngsi-ld-context.json. Kept apart because JSON-LD 1.1 forbids extra keys in term definitions; never served.

notes.@context: Nekazari Platform NGSI-LD @context. One platform namespace: https://nkz-os.org/ns/ (prefix nkz:). Terms with an official Smart Data Model or SAREF4AGRI IRI map there; everything else is a platform extension under nkz:. Do not introduce a second self-namespace: changing a term's IRI re-expands the attribute in the broker and orphans data already written under the old one.
notes.AgriCropObservation: Platform extension of SDM AgriCrop (which lacks observation/image capture semantics).
notes.AgriDevice: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Legacy device type used by DaTaK setup scripts. Prefer AgriSensor for new entities.
notes.AgriEnergyTracker: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Energy production/consumption tracking for agricultural installations.
notes.AgriEquipment: Platform extension — no SDM type exists for generic agricultural equipment. Used as parent type for tractors and implements.
notes.AgriOperation: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriOperation.
notes.AgriParcel: SAREF4AGRI AgriParcel — canonical type used by GIS-Routing for parcel creation. Legacy mapping: nkz:AgriParcel.
notes.AgriParcelOperation: Platform extension — SDM AgriParcelOperation lacks agricultural machinery kinematics properties. Platform extends with A-B lines and VRA fields.
notes.AgriPlant: SDM proposal (smart-data-models/incubated#283): individual plant (tree, vine, shrub) followed over time
notes.AgriPlantSample: SDM proposal (smart-data-models/incubated#283): plant tissue sample with laboratory results
notes.AgriRobot: Alias for AgriculturalRobot — both resolve to nkz:AgriculturalRobot. Robotics module uses AgriRobot as entity type. Standardized 2026-05-08.
notes.AgriSensor: Platform extension — SAREF4AGRI has no AgriSensor class (only specific sensor types like Pluviometer, Thermometer). Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriSensor.
notes.AgriSoilExtended: SDM-001 Proposal: Extension of AgriSoil with soil horizon data and pedotransfer function properties (LUCAS/SoilGrids integration)
notes.AgriSoilSample: SDM proposal (smart-data-models/incubated#283): soil sample of one depth interval with laboratory results
notes.AgriculturalImplement: Platform extension — no SDM type exists for agricultural implements. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriculturalImplement.
notes.AgriculturalMachine: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Generic agricultural machinery parent type for tractors and implements.
notes.AgriculturalRobot: Platform extension — no equivalent in SAREF4AGRI or any SDM catalog. Alias: AgriRobot (robotics module) maps to same nkz:AgriculturalRobot URI. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriculturalRobot.
notes.AgriculturalTractor: Platform extension — no SDM type exists for agricultural tractors. Closest: ManufacturingMachine. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriculturalTractor.
notes.Alert: Platform extension — sensor health alert entity. Created by sensor-health-beat when reliabilityStatus transitions to error and isSilenced==false.
notes.CarbonStock: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Soil organic carbon stock assessment per parcel.
notes.CropHealthAssessment: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Proposed for FIWARE Smart Data Models AgriFood domain (P1). Crop health evaluation result from epidemiological models.
notes.Device: Official SDM dataModel.Device. Canonical type for a provisioned physical sensor. Replaces the platform extension AgriSensor.
notes.DeviceCommand: Platform extension — MQTT device command tracking. Records command lifecycle (pending -> sent/failed) for IoT device management.
notes.DeviceMeasurement: Official SDM dataModel.Device. Canonical carrier for a reading. One entity per (device, controlledProperty), overwritten; history lives in TimescaleDB.
notes.DeviceModel: Official SDM dataModel.Device. The make and model a Device is an instance of; a Device points to it with refDeviceModel.
notes.brandName: Official attribute of SDM DeviceModel, mapped to the Device subject IRI. Smart Data Models gives brandName, manufacturerName and modelName another IRI in the Battery subject (StorageBatteryDevice); a context can map a name once, so that side is a recorded deviation (config/sdm/deviations.json).
notes.DigitalAsset: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. LiDAR point cloud and 3D model assets.
notes.DiseaseRiskAssessment: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Proposed for FIWARE Smart Data Models AgriFood domain (P1). Daily disease risk evaluation per parcel.
notes.EOProduct: FIWARE Smart Data Model — Earth Observation product (Sentinel-1 GRD, Sentinel-2 NDVI, etc.). Properties: productType, hasAgriParcel, backscatterVV, backscatterVH, ndviValue, dateObserved.
notes.EnergyMeter: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Energy metering device for Odoo ERP integration.
notes.EnergyStorageSystem: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:EnergyStorageSystem.
notes.LivestockAnimal: Platform extension — SAREF4AGRI has no LivestockAnimal class. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:LivestockAnimal.
notes.LivestockFarm: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:LivestockFarm.
notes.LivestockGroup: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:LivestockGroup.
notes.LivestockProduction: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:LivestockProduction.
notes.ManufacturingMachine: Official SDM. Canonical type for tractors, implements and field robots, discriminated by the category attribute. Already consumed by gis-routing.
notes.PhotovoltaicInstallation: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:PhotovoltaicInstallation.
notes.SatelliteImageObservation: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:SatelliteImageObservation.
notes.SoilDerivedRaster: SDM-004 Proposal: Raster derived from point samples or gridded soil models (COG/NetCDF storage)
notes.SoilSamplingPoint: SDM-002 Proposal: Point sample location with laboratory analysis results and spatial reference
notes.SoilSurvey: SDM-003 Proposal: Survey campaign metadata (instrumentation, point count, spatial coverage)
notes.VegetationIndex: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:VegetationIndex.
notes.WaterQualityObserved: Official SDM dataModel.WaterQuality. Nitrate content of irrigation water, credited in the nutrient plan.
notes.WeatherForecast: SDM oficial dataModel.Weather. Lleva los agregados diarios (dayMinimum/dayMaximum) que WeatherObserved no define: el SDM modela WeatherObserved como observación instantánea.
notes.WeatherObserved: Platform extension — SAREF4AGRI has no WeatherObserved. SDM WeatherObserved exists in dataModel.Weather. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:WeatherObserved.
notes.controlledAsset: Official SDM Device property. The asset a device monitors — sole canonical device-to-parcel link. Replaces the platform-specific parcelId property.
notes.observesFeature: SDM Device has no feature-of-interest relation; maps to W3C SOSA sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest
notes.timeSource: Provenance of dateObserved: device (reported by the device) or server (receipt time fallback)
notes.observationContext: Medium a device measures (air, soil, plant, water) and where in it; SDM Device has no such property
notes.channelOverrides: Per-channel feature or context that differs from the device default; SDM Device has no per-channel model
notes.mobility: Whether a device stays in place (fixed) or moves (mobile); SDM Device has no such property
notes.deploymentId: Id of the device's current deployment, linking it to its versioned installation history; not modelled in SDM
notes.EOSatelliteImagery: FIWARE Smart Data Model (dataModel.SatelliteImagery) — the analysis of one satellite acquisition over an area: the product it came from, the area processed, the output layer and the resulting values.
notes.sensingDate: Official attribute of SDM EOProduct and EOSatelliteImagery (date and time of the acquisition), mapped to the SatelliteImagery subject IRI.
notes.productType: Official attribute of SDM EOProduct and EOSatelliteImagery (type of the satellite product, e.g. S2MSI2A, GRD), mapped to the SatelliteImagery subject IRI.
notes.provider: Official attribute of SDM EOSatelliteImagery (the provider of the algorithm), mapped to the SatelliteImagery subject IRI. Smart Data Models gives the same name another IRI in the Device subject; a single platform context can hold only one, and no platform entity uses the Device one.
notes.analytics: Official attribute of SDM EOSatelliteImagery (list of name/value pairs, value is a string). The model's schema defines it but the subject's published context does not list it yet, so the IRI here follows the Smart Data Models naming convention.
notes.AgriApp: Official SDM dataModel.Agrifood. An application of the agrifood domain; the source a relatedSource entry refers to.
notes.AgriProductType: Official SDM dataModel.Agrifood. A product type, including crop varieties (category cropVariety); an operation points to it with hasAgriProductType.
notes.cropManagement: Organic or conventional production of one crop cycle, on its sowing operation; not modelled in SDM
notes.declaredCampaigns: Past campaigns of a parcel declared without dates (crop, variety, yield, fallow); SDM has no undated crop history
notes.hasSowingOperation: Relationship from a field operation to the sowing operation that opened its crop cycle; not modelled in SDM
notes.actualETmm: CropHealthAssessment: actual crop evapotranspiration of the day, in mm; not modelled in SDM
notes.asiPct: CropHealthAssessment: Agricultural Stress Index, in percent
notes.compactionAdvisory: CropHealthAssessment: code of the compaction advice; not modelled in SDM
notes.compactionMoistureWarning: CropHealthAssessment: whether the soil moisture raises the compaction risk; not modelled in SDM
notes.compactionRequiresVerification: CropHealthAssessment: whether the compaction risk needs a check in the field; not modelled in SDM
notes.compactionRiskFactors: CropHealthAssessment: factors that contribute to the compaction risk; not modelled in SDM
notes.compactionRiskLevel: CropHealthAssessment: soil compaction risk class; not modelled in SDM
notes.compactionRiskScore: CropHealthAssessment: soil compaction risk score, 0 to 100; not modelled in SDM
notes.compactionSusceptibilityScore: CropHealthAssessment: susceptibility of the soil to compaction, 0 to 100; not modelled in SDM
notes.compactionVigorConcern: CropHealthAssessment: whether low vigour suggests compaction; not modelled in SDM
notes.compositeStageKy: CropHealthAssessment: yield response factor of the stage used in the composite stress index (FAO-33 Ky); not modelled in SDM
notes.compositeStressIndex: CropHealthAssessment: weighted stress index combining water, thermal and vigour stress, 0 to 100; not modelled in SDM
notes.compositeThermalContribution: CropHealthAssessment: contribution of thermal stress to the composite stress index; not modelled in SDM
notes.compositeVigorContribution: CropHealthAssessment: contribution of vigour to the composite stress index; not modelled in SDM
notes.compositeWaterContribution: CropHealthAssessment: contribution of water stress to the composite stress index; not modelled in SDM
notes.cwsiBaselineId: CropHealthAssessment: identifier of the published baseline of the Crop Water Stress Index
notes.cwsiDataFidelity: CropHealthAssessment: fidelity class of the inputs of the Crop Water Stress Index
notes.cwsiLstDate: CropHealthAssessment: acquisition date of the land surface temperature behind the Crop Water Stress Index
notes.cwsiTempSource: CropHealthAssessment: source of the canopy temperature of the Crop Water Stress Index
notes.cwsiValue: CropHealthAssessment: Crop Water Stress Index, 0 to 1
notes.deepPercolationMm: CropHealthAssessment: water lost below the root zone in the day, in mm; not modelled in SDM
notes.depletionFractionP: CropHealthAssessment: fraction of the available soil water the crop can deplete before stress (FAO-56 p), 0 to 1; not modelled in SDM
notes.dominantStressor: CropHealthAssessment: main source of stress (water, thermal, vigor or none); not modelled in SDM
notes.growthAnomaly: CropHealthAssessment: departure of growth from the expected value; not modelled in SDM
notes.irrigationMm: CropHealthAssessment: irrigation need derived from the soil water balance, in mm
notes.kc: CropHealthAssessment: crop coefficient at the current stage (FAO-56); not modelled in SDM
notes.mdsRatio: CropHealthAssessment: maximum daily shrinkage over its reference value
notes.mdsSeverity: CropHealthAssessment: severity class of the maximum daily shrinkage
notes.mdsValue: CropHealthAssessment: maximum daily shrinkage of the trunk, in micrometres
notes.meteoFidelity: CropHealthAssessment: fidelity class of each weather variable used in the assessment; not modelled in SDM
notes.overallSeverity: CropHealthAssessment: overall severity class of the assessment; not modelled in SDM
notes.phenologyDeviation: CropHealthAssessment: departure of the phenology from the expected calendar; not modelled in SDM
notes.phenologySource: CropHealthAssessment: source of the phenology parameters; not modelled in SDM
notes.phenologyStage: CropHealthAssessment, CropAdvisory: current phenological stage of the crop; not modelled in SDM
notes.recommendedAction: CropHealthAssessment: action recommended by the assessment; not modelled in SDM
notes.sarDataFidelity: CropHealthAssessment: fidelity class of the radar inputs; not modelled in SDM
notes.sarFloodStage: CropHealthAssessment: flood stage class seen by radar imagery; not modelled in SDM
notes.sarIsFlooded: CropHealthAssessment: whether radar imagery shows the parcel flooded; not modelled in SDM
notes.sarSurfaceMoisture: CropHealthAssessment: surface moisture index from radar backscatter, 0 to 1; not modelled in SDM
notes.sarWaterloggingRisk: CropHealthAssessment: waterlogging risk class from radar imagery; not modelled in SDM
notes.seasonStart: CropHealthAssessment: date the degree-day accumulation of the crop cycle starts; not modelled in SDM
notes.shadeFraction: CropHealthAssessment: daily fraction of photosynthetically active radiation intercepted by the panels, 0 to 1
notes.shadeObservedAt: CropHealthAssessment: time of the last radiation sample behind the shade fraction
notes.soilAWCmm: CropHealthAssessment: available water capacity of the root zone, in mm; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilClayPct: CropHealthAssessment, CarbonAssessment: clay content of the soil, in percent; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilDataSource: CropHealthAssessment: identifier of the dataset the soil properties come from; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilFieldCapacity: CropHealthAssessment: volumetric water content at field capacity, in cm3/cm3; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilKsatMmH: CropHealthAssessment: saturated hydraulic conductivity of the soil, in mm/h; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilSandPct: CropHealthAssessment: sand content of the soil, in percent; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilScsGroup: CropHealthAssessment: SCS hydrologic soil group (A to D); not modelled in SDM
notes.soilStressLevel: CropHealthAssessment: water stress class given by the soil water balance; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilSuitabilityConfidence: CropHealthAssessment: confidence class of the soil suitability verdict; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilSuitabilityDetail: CropHealthAssessment: soil suitability result per factor (pH, texture, drainage); not modelled in SDM
notes.soilSuitabilityReason: CropHealthAssessment: main reason for the soil suitability verdict; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilSuitabilitySource: CropHealthAssessment: source of the crop soil requirements behind the verdict; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilSuitabilityVerdict: CropHealthAssessment: verdict on the suitability of the soil for the crop; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilWaterConfidence: CropHealthAssessment: confidence class of the soil water estimate; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilWaterMm: CropHealthAssessment: water stored in the root zone, in mm; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilWaterRatio: CropHealthAssessment: water stored in the root zone over its available water capacity, 0 to 1; not modelled in SDM
notes.soilWiltingPoint: CropHealthAssessment: volumetric water content at wilting point, in cm3/cm3; not modelled in SDM
notes.stageProgressPct: CropHealthAssessment: progress within the current stage, in percent; not modelled in SDM
notes.stressCoefficientKs: CropHealthAssessment: water stress coefficient (FAO-56 Ks), 0 to 1; not modelled in SDM
notes.tci: CropHealthAssessment: Temperature Condition Index, 0 to 100; not modelled in SDM
notes.tciSource: CropHealthAssessment: source of the temperature behind the Temperature Condition Index; not modelled in SDM
notes.thermalCondition: CropHealthAssessment: thermal condition of the crop (no_stress, heat or frost classes); not modelled in SDM
notes.thermalDataFidelity: CropHealthAssessment: fidelity class of the thermal inputs; not modelled in SDM
notes.thermalSeverity: CropHealthAssessment: severity class of the thermal condition; not modelled in SDM
notes.underPanelWaterStressFidelity: CropHealthAssessment: fidelity class of the inputs of the under-panel water stress index
notes.underPanelWaterStressIndex: CropHealthAssessment: water stress index under solar panels, 0 (no stress) to 1 (full stress)
notes.underPanelWaterStressObservedAt: CropHealthAssessment: time of the observation behind the under-panel water stress index
notes.vci: CropHealthAssessment: Vegetation Condition Index, 0 to 100; not modelled in SDM
notes.vhi: CropHealthAssessment: Vegetation Health Index, 0 to 100; not modelled in SDM
notes.vigorCondition: CropHealthAssessment: crop vigour class; not modelled in SDM
notes.vigorDataFidelity: CropHealthAssessment: fidelity class of the vigour inputs; not modelled in SDM
notes.vigorIndex: CropHealthAssessment: crop vigour index, 0 to 1; not modelled in SDM
notes.vigorIndexUsed: CropHealthAssessment: name of the vegetation index behind the vigour index; not modelled in SDM
notes.vpdKpa: CropHealthAssessment: vapour pressure deficit of the air, in kPa
notes.waterBalanceDeficit: CropHealthAssessment: precipitation minus crop evapotranspiration, in mm; not modelled in SDM
notes.waterDeficitMm: CropHealthAssessment: water deficit of the root zone, in mm; not modelled in SDM
notes.waterStressFidelity: CropHealthAssessment: fidelity class of the inputs of the water stress index; not modelled in SDM
notes.waterStressIndex: CropHealthAssessment: water stress index, 0 (no stress) to 1 (full stress); not modelled in SDM
notes.waterStressLevel: CropHealthAssessment: water stress class of the parcel (none, mild, moderate, high, no_data or not_needed); not modelled in SDM
notes.waterStressMethod: CropHealthAssessment: method behind the water stress class (cwsi_sensor, balance or none); not modelled in SDM
notes.waterStressObservedAt: CropHealthAssessment: time of the observation behind the water stress index; not modelled in SDM
notes.waterStressPhaseBasis: CropHealthAssessment: data used to decide the stage behind the water stress class (gdd or gdd_ndvi)
notes.waterStressPhaseNote: CropHealthAssessment: note on the water stress class at this stage (rdi: regulated deficit irrigation)
notes.waterStressReferenceSources: CropHealthAssessment: identifiers of the published references behind the water stress class; not modelled in SDM
notes.waterloggingDrainageRateMmH: CropHealthAssessment: drainage rate of the soil, in mm/h; not modelled in SDM
notes.waterloggingExcessMm: CropHealthAssessment: water in excess of the storage of the root zone, in mm; not modelled in SDM
notes.waterloggingRiskLevel: CropHealthAssessment: waterlogging risk class; not modelled in SDM
notes.waterloggingSaturationHours: CropHealthAssessment: estimated hours of saturation, in hours; not modelled in SDM
notes.wueBiomassKg: CropHealthAssessment: estimated biomass used in the water use efficiency, in kg/ha; not modelled in SDM
notes.wueKgM3: CropHealthAssessment: water use efficiency, in kg of biomass per m3 of water
notes.wueStatus: CropHealthAssessment: status of the water use efficiency estimate (operational, advisory or suppressed); not modelled in SDM
notes.wueTrend: CropHealthAssessment: trend of the water use efficiency (improving, stable or declining); not modelled in SDM
notes.wueWaterAppliedMm: CropHealthAssessment: irrigation water applied used in the water use efficiency, in mm; not modelled in SDM
notes.yieldGapConfidence: CropHealthAssessment: confidence class of the yield estimate
notes.yieldUtilizationPct: CropHealthAssessment: share of the maximum yield reached, in percent
